rules.sentence: Acitretin is FDA-approved for psoriasis (severe plaque-type psoriasis, pustular psoriasis generalized, pustular psoriasis localized), combination therapy with ultraviolet B (UVB) or psoralen ultraviolet A (PUVA), combination therapy with cyclosporine, or combination therapy with biologic therapies.
Acitretin is the only systemic retinoid that is FDA-approved for psoriasis and effective as monotherapy.[1]
Acitretin is also used for Darier disease, pityriasis rubra pilaris (PRP), and lamellar ichthyosis.
